title: First Steps: Moving Around
summary: Learn to navigate the workspace using W and S keys

steps.instruction: Welcome to Easy Mode! You'll learn block programming step by step. Press W to move up or S to move down to explore the workspace.
steps.screenReaderHint: Use W key to move cursor up, S key to move cursor down. Focus is currently on the workspace.

steps.instruction: Great! Now navigate to the print block. It's the only block available right now. Use W and S to find it.
steps.screenReaderHint: Print block allows you to display text messages. Navigate with W and S until you hear 'print block'.

steps.instruction: Perfect! You found the print block. Now press E to enter Edit mode so you can change what it says.
steps.screenReaderHint: Press E to toggle Edit mode. Edit mode lets you modify blocks and connect them together.

steps.instruction: Good! You're now in Edit mode. Press Escape to exit Edit mode and return to Navigation mode.
steps.screenReaderHint: Press Escape to leave Edit mode and return to Navigation mode.

steps.instruction: Excellent! You've learned the basics: W and S navigate, E enters Edit mode, and Escape exits. You're ready for the next lesson!
steps.screenReaderHint: Lesson complete. You can now navigate the workspace and toggle Edit mode. Press Enter or click Continue to proceed.

hints: Remember: W moves up, S moves down
The print block is in the toolbox. Use W/S to find it
Press E when you're on a block to enter Edit mode
Escape always returns you to the previous state
